card-expiry-input.name: Card Expiry Input
card-expiry-input.purpose: Capture one MM/YY card expiry with numeric keyboard, cc-exp autocomplete, local month and expired-date validation, helper/error copy, and Design System field states.
card-expiry-input.referenceRationale: The reference ZIP shows PaymentCard expiry display values such as 12/28 and 03/27 but no editable expiry field. Design System promotes a bounded expiry field so card enrollment can use the same Input rhythm without inventing a pattern too early.

anatomy.rule: Names the expiry field and remains visible.
Uses Input rhythm, density, focus, and state model.
Signals date capture without replacing label or helper.
Formats digits as MM/YY while preserving raw digits for callbacks.
Uses month and expired-date checks only for local recovery.

card-expiry-input.statePrecedence: disabled > loading > error > valid > filled > default

Energy.decision: Use semantic field surface, error, valid, and disabled color.
Energy.behavior: Expiry state is visible and contrast-safe.
Energy.example: Invalid month or expired date state.

Voice.decision: Use direct helper and recovery copy without implying approval.
Voice.behavior: Users know whether to correct local structure.
Voice.rejectIf: Copy says the card is approved.

Frame.decision: Reuse Input geometry, density, and full-width behavior.

Momentum.decision: Use Design System focus and loading motion only.

State.decision: Disabled and loading resolve before local validation.
State.example: Loading backend check after valid local expiry.
State.rejectIf: Invalid and valid are both shown.

Accessibility.decision: Use label, describedby, aria-invalid, inputmode numeric, autocomplete cc-exp, and paste-friendly formatting.
Accessibility.behavior: The field is operable with keyboard, paste, and assistive tech.
Accessibility.rejectIf: No label or missing invalid state.

Depth.decision: Keep card expiry as a field-level surface; enrollment depth belongs to patterns.
Depth.behavior: The component does not open nested payment or ownership flows.

Tone.decision: Use direct recovery tone for local validation and avoid approval language.
Tone.behavior: The user knows whether to correct the expiry.

Growth.decision: Escalate card number, security code, tokenization, and ownership to sibling components or patterns.
Growth.behavior: Card Expiry remains one capture component.

Symbol.decision: Use the calendar symbol as an affordance beside visible label and helper text.
Symbol.behavior: Icon reinforces expiry capture without replacing text.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizing and alignment inside the field control.
Iconography.behavior: Calendar icon aligns with Input rhythm across density.

props.name: error
props.notes: Visible recovery message; overrides local expiry message.

props.name: loading
props.notes: Shows a check in progress without claiming approval.

props.name: onValueChange
props.notes: Called with formatted value, raw digits, month, year, validity, and expired flag.

do: Use for one card expiry date.
Use local validation only for month and expiration.
dont: Do not own card number, CVC, tokenization, ownership, or submit system.
info: Full card enrollment becomes a pattern after Card Number, Expiry, and Security Code components exist.

tests: MM/YY formatting on input and paste
Valid, invalid month, expired, incomplete, and empty states
rejectIf: The component owns backend validation, tokenization, card ownership, or submission.
Expired or invalid state is color-only.
The value is not formatted or cannot be corrected.
Autocomplete and numeric input mode are missing.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: large field with grouped number and close helper text
standard onboarding or wallet form field
dense admin or support form row

agentInstructions: Use Card Expiry Input for one MM/YY expiry.
Ask before adding card number, CVC, tokenization, backend validation, or card ownership.
Keep autocomplete cc-exp, numeric input mode, helper/error association, and expiry recovery visible.
